messages:
Ivy (SE): Acme POC failing: function-calls + json_mode producing parse errors and occasional 429s. Need quick help.
Liam (AE): Demo in ~8 hours, customer blocked.
Ivy (SE): Example log: `JSONDecodeError` — sometimes payloads are double-escaped like `\\\"result\\\": {...}`.
Kai (Eng): Are you using streaming? stream + strict json_mode can produce partial frames and broken JSON.
Ivy (SE): yes stream=true.
Kai (Eng): Quick fix: set `stream:false` for demo or use `json_mode:"relaxed"` and limit `max_output_tokens`. Also add client-side schema validation (ajv) before downstream processing.
Liam (AE): 429s look like burst limits. Can we get a short capacity bump?
quota-bot: Temporary quota request created (#Q-921). Please provide expected QPS/time window.
Ivy (SE): I'll gather QPS and share. Disabling stream fixed parsing in our repro. Will add sanitizer and send runbook.
Liam (AE): Thanks team, please cc me on the quota ticket.
